human_step_request.velocity_source: Measured world pose finite difference between consecutive native ticks; not commanded body velocity

human_step_reply.group_timing: groups_before belongs to current interval; update at following step

clock.reset: Fresh episode/worker session; current worker accepts epoch0 only
clock.discontinuity: Fatal/restart_required; no extrapolation or hidden retry
clock.start_gate: Accepted navigation goal simulation stamp; freeze human lifecycle until gate
